answer: Let the registry whisper an unpredictable summons: each epoch it draws a random order through the nebula of identities minted in the last three epochs, and each must appear within an hour for a live ten-minute session with a rotating auditor, defending one attested transaction live. Passing earns a dated ivory seal on the public record; missing the call or failing voids the identity and forfeits its rewards, half funding the auditor bounty. Faking 1,000 puppets means hiring 1,000 stand-ins at $60 a session, $60,000 in all, while one honest agent passes a single free session.
